spec.description: Pares IP amostrados do Huawei. Tráfego estimado, ifIndex bruto e GeoLite2 quando disponível; não é tráfego único de clientes.

spec.rawSql: SELECT t.asn AS 'ASN',t.nome AS 'Nome',t.ip AS 'IP origem',t.bloco AS 'Bloco',COALESCE(cn.name,NULLIF(t.pais,''),'Não informado') AS 'País',t.vol AS 'Volume',t.bps AS 'Taxa média',t.pps AS 'Pacotes/s médio' FROM (SELECT src_ip AS ip,MAX(src_asn) AS asn,COALESCE(MAX(NULLIF(src_asn_name,'')),'Não identificado') AS nome,COALESCE(MAX(NULLIF(src_prefix,'')),'—') AS bloco,MAX(NULLIF(src_country,'')) AS pais,SUM(total_bytes) AS vol,SUM(total_bytes)*8/GREATEST(1,$__unixEpochTo()-$__unixEpochFrom()) AS bps,SUM(total_packets)/GREATEST(1,$__unixEpochTo()-$__unixEpochFrom()) AS pps FROM orby_ip_pairs_minute WHERE source='huawei' AND $__timeFilter(bucket_utc) GROUP BY src_ip ORDER BY SUM(total_bytes) DESC LIMIT 30) AS t LEFT JOIN orby_country_names AS cn ON cn.code=t.pais ORDER BY t.vol DESC
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT dst_ip) AS value FROM orby_ip_pairs_minute WHERE source='huawei' AND $__timeFilter(bucket_utc)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM (SELECT src_ip,dst_ip FROM orby_ip_pairs_minute WHERE source='huawei' AND $__timeFilter(bucket_utc) GROUP BY src_ip,dst_ip) t

spec.title: Último fluxo Huawei UTC (independente do filtro)

spec.rawSql: SELECT MAX(bucket_utc) AS 'Último fluxo Huawei (UTC)' FROM orby_ip_pairs_minute WHERE source='huawei'

SELECT t.latitude,t.longitude,COALESCE(cn.name,NULLIF(t.pais,''),'Não informado') AS 'País',t.asn AS 'ASN',t.nome AS 'Nome',t.ips AS 'IPs de origem',t.vol AS 'Volume' FROM (SELECT src_latitude AS latitude,src_longitude AS longitude,src_asn AS asn,COALESCE(MAX(NULLIF(src_asn_name,'')),'Não identificado') AS nome,MAX(NULLIF(src_country,'')) AS pais,COUNT(DISTINCT src_ip) AS ips,SUM(total_bytes) AS vol FROM orby_ip_pairs_minute WHERE source='huawei' AND $__timeFilter(bucket_utc) AND src_latitude IS NOT NULL AND src_longitude IS NOT NULL GROUP BY src_latitude,src_longitude,src_asn ORDER BY SUM(total_bytes) DESC LIMIT 300) AS t LEFT JOIN orby_country_names AS cn ON cn.code=t.pais ORDER BY t.vol DESC

SELECT COALESCE(cn.name,NULLIF(t.pais,''),'Não informado') AS 'País',t.ips AS 'IPs distintos',t.vol AS 'Volume',t.bps AS 'Taxa média',t.pps AS 'Pacotes/s médio' FROM (SELECT src_country AS pais,COUNT(DISTINCT src_ip) AS ips,SUM(total_bytes) AS vol,SUM(total_bytes)*8/GREATEST(1,$__unixEpochTo()-$__unixEpochFrom()) AS bps,SUM(total_packets)/GREATEST(1,$__unixEpochTo()-$__unixEpochFrom()) AS pps FROM orby_ip_pairs_minute WHERE source='huawei' AND $__timeFilter(bucket_utc) AND src_country<>'' GROUP BY src_country ORDER BY SUM(total_bytes) DESC LIMIT 30) AS t LEFT JOIN orby_country_names AS cn ON cn.code=t.pais ORDER BY t.vol DESC

SELECT t.asn AS 'ASN',t.nome AS 'Nome',t.ip AS 'IP destino',t.bloco AS 'Bloco',COALESCE(cn.name,NULLIF(t.pais,''),'Não informado') AS 'País',t.vol AS 'Volume',t.bps AS 'Taxa média',t.pps AS 'Pacotes/s médio' FROM (SELECT dst_ip AS ip,MAX(dst_asn) AS asn,COALESCE(MAX(NULLIF(dst_asn_name,'')),'Não identificado') AS nome,COALESCE(MAX(NULLIF(dst_prefix,'')),'—') AS bloco,MAX(NULLIF(dst_country,'')) AS pais,SUM(total_bytes) AS vol,SUM(total_bytes)*8/GREATEST(1,$__unixEpochTo()-$__unixEpochFrom()) AS bps,SUM(total_packets)/GREATEST(1,$__unixEpochTo()-$__unixEpochFrom()) AS pps FROM orby_ip_pairs_minute WHERE source='huawei' AND $__timeFilter(bucket_utc) GROUP BY dst_ip ORDER BY SUM(total_bytes) DESC LIMIT 30) AS t LEFT JOIN orby_country_names AS cn ON cn.code=t.pais ORDER BY t.vol DESC

spec.title: Atraso da última coleta Huawei (min; agora)
spec.description: Independente do período selecionado; negativo indica horário do fluxo no futuro. Ajuda a entender painéis vazios em 15/30 minutos.

spec.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,MAX(bucket_utc),UTC_TIMESTAMP())/60,1) AS value FROM orby_ip_pairs_minute WHERE source='huawei'

spec.title: Pares origem e destino / principais portas

spec.rawSql: SELECT src_ip AS 'Origem',dst_ip AS 'Destino',protocol AS 'Protocolo',dst_port AS 'Porta',CASE WHEN input_if=0 THEN 'sem interface (0)' ELSE COALESCE(MAX(im_in.if_name),CONCAT('ifIndex ',input_if,' (sem nome)')) END AS 'Entrada Huawei',CASE WHEN output_if=0 THEN 'sem interface (0)' ELSE COALESCE(MAX(im_out.if_name),CONCAT('ifIndex ',output_if,' (sem nome)')) END AS 'Saída Huawei',ROUND(SUM(total_bytes),0) AS 'Volume estimado' FROM orby_ip_pairs_minute LEFT JOIN orby_interface_names AS im_in ON im_in.source='huawei' AND im_in.if_index=input_if LEFT JOIN orby_interface_names AS im_out ON im_out.source='huawei' AND im_out.if_index=output_if WHERE orby_ip_pairs_minute.source='huawei' AND $__timeFilter(bucket_utc) GROUP BY src_ip,dst_ip,protocol,dst_port,input_if,output_if ORDER BY SUM(total_bytes) DESC LIMIT 40

SELECT CASE WHEN input_if=0 THEN 'sem interface (0)' ELSE COALESCE(MAX(im_in.if_name),CONCAT('ifIndex ',input_if,' (sem nome)')) END AS 'Entrada Huawei',CASE WHEN output_if=0 THEN 'sem interface (0)' ELSE COALESCE(MAX(im_out.if_name),CONCAT('ifIndex ',output_if,' (sem nome)')) END AS 'Saída Huawei',CASE netflow_direction WHEN 0 THEN 'captura na entrada' WHEN 1 THEN 'captura na saída' ELSE 'direção não informada' END AS 'Captura',ROUND(SUM(total_bytes),0) AS 'Volume estimado',SUM(flow_records) AS 'Registros' FROM orby_ip_pairs_minute LEFT JOIN orby_interface_names AS im_in ON im_in.source='huawei' AND im_in.if_index=input_if LEFT JOIN orby_interface_names AS im_out ON im_out.source='huawei' AND im_out.if_index=output_if WHERE orby_ip_pairs_minute.source='huawei' AND $__timeFilter(bucket_utc) GROUP BY input_if,output_if,netflow_direction ORDER BY SUM(total_bytes) DESC LIMIT 30

SELECT src_prefix AS 'Rede',COUNT(DISTINCT src_ip) AS 'IPs observados',ROUND(SUM(total_bytes),0) AS 'Volume estimado' FROM orby_ip_pairs_minute WHERE source='huawei' AND $__timeFilter(bucket_utc) AND src_prefix!='' GROUP BY src_prefix ORDER BY SUM(total_bytes) DESC LIMIT 30

SELECT dst_prefix AS 'Rede',COUNT(DISTINCT dst_ip) AS 'IPs observados',ROUND(SUM(total_bytes),0) AS 'Volume estimado' FROM orby_ip_pairs_minute WHERE source='huawei' AND $__timeFilter(bucket_utc) AND dst_prefix!='' GROUP BY dst_prefix ORDER BY SUM(total_bytes) DESC LIMIT 30

spec.title: Top ASNs de origem
spec.description: ASN/pais GeoLite2 somente quando conhecido, sem dados inventados.

spec.rawSql: SELECT t.asn AS 'ASN',t.nome AS 'Nome',t.blocos AS 'Blocos / IPs',t.ips AS 'IPs',CASE WHEN t.paises>1 THEN 'Vários' ELSE COALESCE(cn.name,NULLIF(t.pais,''),'Não informado') END AS 'País',t.vol AS 'Volume',t.bps AS 'Taxa média',t.pps AS 'Pacotes/s médio' FROM (SELECT src_asn AS asn,COALESCE(MAX(NULLIF(src_asn_name,'')),'Não identificado') AS nome,COALESCE(NULLIF(GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT NULLIF(src_prefix,'') ORDER BY src_prefix SEPARATOR ', ' LIMIT 3),''),GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT src_ip ORDER BY src_ip SEPARATOR ', ' LIMIT 3)) AS blocos,COUNT(DISTINCT src_ip) AS ips,COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(src_country,'')) AS paises,MAX(NULLIF(src_country,'')) AS pais,SUM(total_bytes) AS vol,SUM(total_bytes)*8/GREATEST(1,$__unixEpochTo()-$__unixEpochFrom()) AS bps,SUM(total_packets)/GREATEST(1,$__unixEpochTo()-$__unixEpochFrom()) AS pps FROM orby_ip_pairs_minute WHERE source='huawei' AND $__timeFilter(bucket_utc) AND src_asn>0 GROUP BY src_asn ORDER BY SUM(total_bytes) DESC LIMIT 30) AS t LEFT JOIN orby_country_names AS cn ON cn.code=t.pais ORDER BY t.vol DESC

spec.title: Taxa estimada por interface de entrada Huawei

spec.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(bucket_utc,'1m'),CASE WHEN input_if=0 THEN 'sem interface (0)' ELSE COALESCE(CONCAT(im_in.if_name,' (',input_if,')'),CONCAT('ifIndex ',input_if,' (sem nome)')) END AS metric,ROUND(SUM(total_bytes)*8/60,2) AS value FROM orby_ip_pairs_minute LEFT JOIN orby_interface_names AS im_in ON im_in.source='huawei' AND im_in.if_index=input_if WHERE orby_ip_pairs_minute.source='huawei' AND $__timeFilter(bucket_utc) GROUP BY 1,input_if,im_in.if_name ORDER BY 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT src_ip) AS value FROM orby_ip_pairs_minute WHERE source='huawei' AND $__timeFilter(bucket_utc)
